answer_1.quote: We introduce a model capable of directly generating fluent spoken audio captions of images without the need for natural language text, either as an intermediate representation or a form of supervision during training

answer_2.quote: We consider two sets of end-to-end metrics: word-based and retrieval-based, and one set of proxy unit-based metrics.

answer_4.quote: Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) workers performed Side-by-Side preference tests (SXS) and naturalness evaluation based on mean opinion scores (MOS) on a scale from 1 to 5 for each U2S model
answer_4.guideline: workers transcribed and rated captions for naturalness, and performed preference tests between synthesized speech outputs
